players.product: Ultra-fine, high-purity nickel-based powders for MLCC electrodes (volume supply to global MLCC makers); also copper and silver-coated copper powders

quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: copper-based products made H1 2026 revenue of RMB 191,814,931.88, 23.20% of main-business revenue, up 12.24 percentage points from a year earlier; its copper powder passed multi-batch sample validation at leading domestic photovoltaic companies and moved from R&D to volume production. Its new capacity projects are progressing as planned, and it plans capacity prudently against customer demand and orders.
quarterly_data.figure: copper-based products 23.20% of H1 2026 main-business revenue (+12.24 points)
